How to read ✕

Levels

A layer above sets a property, or leaves the one below. The most specific active level wins.

FACTORYShipped defaults. PROFILEThe class pack. A PROFILE bundle covers every loop of this class pack that has no LOOP bundle. SITEEvery loop of the site without a PROFILE or LOOP bundle. LOOPOverrides the profile for this loop only. UnsetNo layer sets it.

Change class

PolicyRe-evaluated on complete qualified support under one bundle; old and new values never mix inside one result. ◆ State boundaryA STATE_BOUNDARY change opens a new epoch: windows whose support began before the effective time report WAITING (warm-up) instead of a mixed result. ✕ DeploymentA DEPLOYMENT-class change ships in a build; the workers refuse it as a bundle.

Flags

commissioningCommissioning required: the catalogue has no starting value. unread by buildNot read by this build; the reason is in the property's panel. invalidA validation error names this property.

Bundle state

Bundles in progress: drafts, validated, shadowed, approved or failed - active and superseded ones live on their loop's page.

○DraftEditable. ◐Validated …Validated, Shadow evaluated, Approved, Scheduled, Prepared: on its way. ✓Active (verified)Every required worker applied it and a result carries its hash. ✕Activation failed …Rejected, Approval expired, Partially acknowledged, Activation failed: not active. ↺Rolled back ⊘SupersededSettled.
